name: S6 — a selection in a post survives the words that arrive after it
why: The operator drags over a line of an answer while it is still being written, and the next delta must not take it away: that is how they copy a sentence out of a long report without waiting for the end of it (13 Nov). In the old chat every update replaces the transcript's markup, so the selection dies on the first delta. In the new one the paragraph's own text node is appended to, so the words the operator chose are still chosen.

parts.text: The report is on its way.

steps.delta: It has three sections: the summary, the numbers, and what to do next.
The numbers are the same ones the plan quotes, so they can be checked against it.
